crossRefs.note: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his…
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable…
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there…
Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
translations.bsb: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
translations.kjv: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
translations.asv: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.
